name: Desktop Groups
author: Matthew Elgert
description: Windows-style virtual desktops for Hyprland: one keypress moves every monitor to a new set of workspaces. This widget shows which desktop you are on and switches between them.

barWidget.description: Dots showing which desktop every monitor is on, and one click to switch.

schema.label: Desktops
schema.description: How many desktops to show. Match the 'desktops' value passed to setup() in hyprland.lua.

schema.label: Workspaces per desktop
schema.description: Workspaces reserved per desktop, matching the 'slots' value in hyprland.lua. Leave at 0 to follow the connected monitor count, which is the module's default.

schema.label: Keybinding prefix
schema.description: Shown in the panel next to each desktop. Match the 'bind' pattern in hyprland.lua; the desktop number is appended.
